The '''''Cutlass''''' was an [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft|Imperial Patrol Craft]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. It was deployed to the [[Sev Tok system/Legends|Sev Tok system]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Untirrka]] where it planned to board the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Argent Lady]]'' under suspicion of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]]. The report of the freighter came in too late to properly prepare the ship and the ship left [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] with only half the normal number of gunners and no support troops. Although the ship was understaffed the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] felt that it was sufficient to deal with an unarmed freighter. What the Empire did not know was that by the time the ''Argent Lady'' reached the Sev Tok system its cargo hold was full of armed and dangerous [[R5-series astromech droid]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Cutlass'' was created by [[Thomas Bowling]] for the article ''[[Droids Defiant]]'' that was published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 9]] in February [[1996]]. It was published as a supplement to [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] created by [[West End Games]].
